name: Bambuddy
description: A powerful, self-hosted print archive and management system for Bambu Lab 3D printers. No cloud dependency, complete privacy, full control. NOTE: This container MUST run in HOST network mode for printer auto-discovery and local slicer integrations to work properly.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent storage location for your SQLite database, custom settings, and print farm configurations.

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: Persistent storage folder where application runtime and printer connection logs are saved.

paths.name: Virtual Printer Storage
paths.description: Persistent storage path for the local Virtual Printer emulation layer, allowing OrcaSlicer/Bambu Studio to handle direct LAN transfers.

variables.name: Time Zone
variables.description: Set the operational time zone for print logs and scheduled tasks.

variables.name: Web UI Port
variables.description: The internal port Bambuddy uses for its web dashboard server. Since Network Mode is locked to 'host', changing this value directly alters the port used on your Unraid host (e.g. http://your-unraid-ip:8000).
